en: Color-tinted historic postcard showing a broad public square with trees, horse-drawn carriages, and pedestrians. Dominating the right side is a large ornate historicist building with elaborate façade details. The caption at the top reads "PÉCS, Széchenyi-tér". The reverse side has handwritten text in Hungarian, an address section with green dividing line, a red Hungarian postage stamp, and a circular postmark.
